en: Traitor Ji Chang! By King Zhou's order, you're coming with me.
Oh no! I never thought King Zhou's pursuers would catch up so fast!
Are you Lord Ji Chang, the Lord of the West?
And you are?
Don't you remember? I'm your 100th son, Leizhenzi, who trained on Mount Zhongnan!
Leizhenzi? You're Leizhenzi!
This half-man, half-crow thing is Leizhenzi? Pa, how'd you sire a freak like that?
And what are you, scrawny monkey? How dare you insult me!
Scrawny monkey? You beaky birdbrain, want to die?
Stop squabbling! You're both my dear boys! But Leizhenzi, how did you...?
Master Yunzhongzi said you were in danger. He fed me an immortal apricot, I turned into this, and I flew to Lintong Pass.
Are you done blabbering yet?
Hmph! One comes, one dies. Two come, I kill the pair!
Not bad, birdbrain!
You're not so bad yourself, monkey!
Quick, let's get out of here!
Yes, Father!
Sh-Shen Gongbao!!
Pingyan, you know him?
Know him? He's the one who killed my dad!
Your life is mine, Ji Chang~ Kill you and history changes! Then I'll slay the Kunlun immortals and drown Xiqi in blood...
History? Good sage, we've never met. Why such hatred?
Enough big talk. Bring it!
D-Damn it~
Ha ha ha~ Brat! So you came to this era too. Don't worry, once Ji Chang is dead, you can join your father...
Shen Gongbao, is it? I'm the one you want. Once I'm dead, let these boys go.
Ha ha ha... So they can avenge you? Do you take me for a fool?
Stop~ Shen Gongbao!
Wh-What is this? Why you... So you're...!? Fine! We'll meet again...
Pingyan~ Are you all right?
What can I get you?
A night's stay is 20 silver.
A night's stay is 20 silver.
Got the summon beast Wuyan Beast!
What do we do! What do we do!
They say the big battle's outside Xiqi. Lord Ji Chang is sure to win!
Chong Houhu leads the army this time. They say his deputy Zhang Guifang knows some nasty magic!
If Lord Ji Chang loses, then Xiqi is...
Waaah~ I'm so scared~
I believe in Lord Ji Chang! Xiqi's army will win this war...
We're done for...
What are we to do? If only I were ten years younger...
Waaah~ I don't wanna die...
Don't worry, Amei! I swear on my life, I won't let anything hurt you!
I'm sure Lord Ji Chang will find a way to get us through this...
Your Highness? King Zhou's troops have invaded. My lord has led the army to the Xiqi outskirts to protect the people. Please hurry northeast to the outskirts and help him!
The Xiqi outskirts, northeast? We're on our way!
Gotta hurry to the Xiqi outskirts and save Pa!
Damn it~
King Zhou's army is way too strong...
I'll defend Xiqi, my home... But can we really win this war?
King Ji Chang is in the command tent at the very top!
Cursed Shang army...
I'll never give up...
The magic that deputy Zhang Guifang uses! It's unbelievable...
I won't give up! Led by King Ji Chang, Xiqi's army will never lose!
My buddy Asan just died on the battlefield...
Curse King Zhou's army! If this keeps up...
Defeat after defeat has shaken morale. If Zhang Guifang's magic keeps stumping us... I fear our whole army will...
Father! I'm back!
Ji Fa? And Pingyan and Leizhenzi... Thank goodness, you're all back...
Father, leave the front to us! Their deputy Zhang Guifang uses magic. Ordinary soldiers would die for nothing. We've grown stronger on the road and met remarkable allies. Entrust the front to us!
That's right! Leave it to us, Pa!
Well...
Don't worry, Father. If you don't trust the monkey, there's me and Second Brother! And lovely Miss Yang Jian here is no pushover either...
Yang Jian?
This humble maiden is Yang Jian, Yuding's disciple. I may not be worthy, but I shall do my very best...
How can I put such a dangerous task on a young girl? Especially against Zhang Guifang...
Zhang Guifang? He's nothing to me! Listen, old man! If you think I'm a frail girl, you're dead wrong! I'm YANG JIAN!!
Miss Yang Jian...
N-No... what this maiden meant was...
Quit the act! Pa's already seen your true nasty colors, loud and clear!
You... you...
Very well! I leave the front to you. But heed my words: Zhang Guifang's magic is truly fearsome. If things get dangerous, retreat!
Got it, Pa!
The front is a heavy duty. Be careful, and retreat at any sign of danger!
There! We're safe now...
Thanks for saving us, old-timer! Oh, and who are you?
Ancient South said Ji Chang's children saved him, so I came to thank you. But Ji Chang says you all lost and got captured...
If that Zhang Guifang hadn't pulled weird Taoist tricks... we'd never have lost...
Huh? You know Ancient South too, old-timer?
Ho ho ho! Don't lose heart over Zhang Guifang. You're not yet ready to take on the sorcerers of Jin'ao Island...
Jin'ao Island!? What's that?
You'll understand soon. To beat Zhang Guifang, we should seek Qingxu Daode Zhenjun at Ziyang Cave on Qingfeng Mountain.
Ziyang Cave!? Qingxu Daode Zhenjun?
Qingfeng Mountain isn't far from here! Let's set off!
Let's? Um, who are you, old-timer...?
Ho ho ho... Silly me, rambling on without introducing myself! I am Jiang Ziya.
Y-You're Jiang Ziya!? I've heard SO much about you!
You know of me, young man?
Of course! You're the hero who helps Zhou topple King Zhou and invest the gods! Whether I get home depends on when you finish that job!
You even know of the Investiture task Yuanshi Tianzun gave me! Who are you...? Your world? Hmm...
You'll understand soon enough!
Ha ha ha ha! Good! Good! Good! I've no idea what you're on about, but I like you!
Please come with us, old-timer!
Ho ho ho, that was my plan. To thank you for saving Ancient South, let me lend you my strength!
Thanks, old-timer... Now I've got a shot at going home! Wonder where Yin Wen and Xiaojun are...
Welcome to Kuafeng Village!
I hear Xiqi's army lost a battle! What'll we do?
Heard of Jin'ao Island? They say evil-magic immortals live there...
From Kuafeng Village, the Trial Cave is northwest and Qingfeng Mountain is north.
There's a summon beast, Sibuxiang, in Xuanyun Cave!
You're Jiang Ziya, aren't you? Fine, fine! A pity, a pity!
Tell me, fellow Taoist, what is fine? And what's a pity?
You're kind and follow Heaven's will, so that's fine. But a cultivator like you should know fate... sigh! A pity, a pity!
A pity, a pity!
We meet again.
You two... I keep running into you!
Life is full of chance meetings. You worry too much, lad.
King Zhou is a tyrant! He dotes on Daji and neglects the court. We can barely survive! Won't someone save us!
If only a wise and kind ruler would come save us.
My dad was hauled off to Zhaoge for forced labor. He never came back.
My son wanted to be an immortal. He ate a pill he brewed himself and died.
Dear, when are you coming home? Xiaokang and I miss you so!
If it isn't Jiang Shang! What wind blew your old bones here?
Ha ha ha~ You know me well, old friend. We're up against a tough foe, and I need your help...
Ho ho! Zhang Guifang of Jin'ao Island, right? Say the word and I'm with you. Take these Golden Dragon Shears! Even with three heads and six arms, he won't stand a chance...
Got the summon Golden Dragon Shears!
Ha ha ha~ Having an old friend like you is my great fortune. I'll repay you in the next life! Ho ho ho...
Go on, get out of here! Enough sweet talk!
Ha ha ha~ I'm off then... Farewell, old friend.
He talked funny today... It's not like we'll never meet again. What's with him...
Are these the ones, Zhu'er?
Uncle South Dragon! No mistake! I'd know those faces even as ashes! They killed my father and brother!
So young, yet so ruthless! I, the North Dragon King, won't let you get away with it!
If it's really you, so be it. I, the West Dragon King, will avenge my brother!
Miss Ao Zhu, please calm down! I really can't waste time with you here. Xiqi is about to fall! Please step aside!
Shut up! Pay for my father's and brother's lives!
Guess I've got no choice. Sorry about this...
Ugh... ugh... curses...

Dragon Kings, I know what happened. Li Jing's son paid with his life, so the feud should end. Hounding them is unkind, and Pingyan has held back again and again. With me, Jiang Shang, here, I'd rather not take your lives. Let's end this.
......If Jiang Shang, Yuanshi Tianzun's disciple, says so, we'll let it end. We take our leave!
Sob...
Kill me! Kill me the way you killed my father and brother!
Miss Ao Zhu... I... sigh...
Hmph! Just you wait! Spare me today, and I'll be back for revenge someday! Murderer! Waaah...

Miss Ao... I know only a little of your story. Everyone is born with a mission. Perhaps your father and brother came into this world to revive Ancient South. Their sacrifice helped others, so it wasn't in vain! Perhaps they watch over you from paradise...
What would you know, you smelly old geezer! Lecture me after you've been through what I have!
......Sigh! What a cursed fate! Cursed!
Remember this, Ji Pingyan! If I don't avenge my father and brother, I'm no daughter of the East Sea Dragon King!
Hurry, check if His Majesty's all right!
Eek~ An assassin~
A shadow just ran off toward the underground city...
His Majesty will be okay, right?
If I catch that assassin, I'll skin him alive...
How dare an assassin attack His Majesty...
Wh-What are we to do...
What do we do? We beat Zhaoge's army today... and now His Majesty's attacked...
Young master, you must find the culprit...
Luckily Jiang Ziya got there in time to save him. But...
...My boys... you've come...
Father...
Pa, are you okay?
I'm... all right... If Jiang hadn't shown up and blocked the fatal blow, I'd be gone by now... Quick, see how badly he's hurt!
Master~ Are you okay? Hang in there...
Pingyan, is that you? I'm fine... Wh-Where's the assassin...
I didn't see anyone! Look at you, you're bleeding so much... You'll be fine, right?
...Old man...
P-Pingyan... I'm fine... The assassin is still hiding in Xiqi. Go find him...
B-But...
Monkey-face! Won't you even listen to your own master?
F-Fine, I get it...
The assassin... fled to the underground... city... Be... careful...
The underground city's entrance is in the great hall. Look closely...
Rest easy, Lord of the West! I, Huang Feihu, will protect them!
I'm counting on you... Prince Wucheng...
Heh heh... We'll see who ends up protecting who...
Beakface! Zip it! Let's go!
Is that so? So the assassin was... Pingyan's friend...
Yes, Father! They grew up together, but as I see it, that Yin Wen is now Grand Tutor Wen.
G-Grand Tutor Wen!? Pingyan's friend is the Grand Tutor himself!
Yes... They were childhood friends, but something happened after they came here. He turned on Pingyan and even tried to kill him... If not for Jiang Ziya, Pingyan would be dead...
Then... is Jiang... unharmed?
I failed... He has passed on...
Jiang... I have wronged you... Cough cough...
Father... Stay strong!
Cough... Where is... Pingyan?
Ever since we got back, he's shut himself in his room. He hasn't come out once... Shall I bring him to you?
No... let him be... He lost his friend and master at once. He needs time alone...
...I understand...
Leizhenzi, my boy...
Yes, Father?
I know... you like bickering... with Pingyan... But this time... is different... Go easy... on him...
Got it... No bickering with the scrawny mon- er, Pingyan for now...
Good... I'm a little tired... You may all... go rest...
We'll take our leave...
Remember Father's words. No bickering with Pingyan! These are dark times...
I know, I know~ Big bro~
Yo~
Scr-Scrawny... Ahem! Pingyan, you're here~
Pingyan!? Ew, cut it out~ Beakface! That's so not you~
What's with you guys? Why the dumb faces?
I'm an idiot for worrying about this idiot.
Ha ha ha! Looks like we worried for nothing! Glad you're fine! Let's step out.
Yeah...
......If you want to cry, just cry.
Who's crying?! Hag! You think I, Ji Pingyan, am some sissy who bawls at the drop of a hat?
Wh-Who said I'd cry... I'm just... just...
Sob... sob... sob...
Sob... Master... Master...
......I understand...
Pa, are you okay?
Is that... Pingyan?
Pa~ I'm sorry... This is all my fault... The assassin turned out to be...
Say no... more! I understand... Don't blame yourself... You never wanted this...
Pa, there's something I have to tell you...
You want... to go to Zhaoge.
Yeah! Before leaving, Yin Wen said: Come to Zhaoge, the one you seek is there! If I go, I'll find out what he meant. And I promised Master I'd finish the Investiture, so...
......Very well! Go! But be careful in Zhaoge... King Zhou has attacked Xiqi, and you're my son... He won't let you be.
Right!
Son!
Hm?
Whatever you do, your Pa... no! Your royal father supports you!
Ha ha ha~ Thanks, Pa!
Call me... Father!
Yes! Royal Pa!
Ha ha ha~
Ha ha ha~
Go now, Pingyan... Good luck... on your journey...
The assassin got away, and His Majesty is badly hurt...
Young master, you must catch the culprit...
Jiang Ziya gave his life to save the young master...
So you finally came out, scrawny monkey!
Mind your own business, birdbrain!
Stop squabbling! Listen... Father was badly wounded. A nation can't go a day without a ruler. With Father down and our eldest brother Bo Yikao gone, Father wants me to take the burden...
So you can't travel with us anymore, bro?
No way! Big bro!
Exactly! Without Brother Ji Fa, who'll keep Monkey-face in line? What if one full-moon night that unevolved monkey tries something on this maiden...
Spare me! I'd never be into a hag like you! Hmph! Just don't try to seduce ME...
Wh-What did you say? I'll tear you apart!
I'll help you, Miss Yang Jian~
Bring it~ Like I'm scared of you!
Enough! Stop it, all of you! You're raising the roof with me right here. Once I'm gone, it'll be chaos!
All right! All right! For the sake of me, Prince Wucheng Huang Feihu, stop fighting!
For YOUR sake? Glad you reminded me! Who bolted at one shout from the Grand Tutor and left us behind? The mighty Prince Wucheng, Huang Feihu! Change your name to Huang Gecko! Ha ha ha~
Beakface~ Wasn't that a bit much? You saw how scary Yin Wen is. He knew it, so he didn't dare fight. Even if he'd stayed, could we have won?
Monkey-face...
Pingyan~ You've grown up!
......Fine! Sorry, Prince Wucheng... But that really hurt...
Ha ha ha~ No worries! And I've decided! I'm staying in Xiqi too! While the Lord of the West recovers, I'll help the heir rule and defend Xiqi!
Didn't I already apologize?
I'm not mad at you! I just feel like I can hear thousands of Xiqi folk begging me to stay!
Sounds good! Stay and help my big bro! Just don't drag him down!
Ha ha ha~ Leave it to me!
Then let's go! Next stop~ Zhaoge!
Yeah!
I won't be there, but don't you lose!
Leave the governing of Xiqi to me!
His Majesty should be all right!
They say King Zhou sent the assassin. So scary~
Waaah~ Is His Majesty okay?
His Majesty will be okay, right?
If I catch that assassin... I'll skin him alive...
Curse King Zhou... sending an assassin to Xiqi...
They say the assassin was Grand Tutor Wen, a top minister! Coming in person!
The young masters beat King Zhou's general Chong Houhu! Amazing!
If Lord Ji Chang falls, then Xiqi is...
I'm sure Prince Ji Fa will lead us through this...
I'll never let another assassin into Xiqi!
Ancient South!
Heading to Zhaoge? Let me take you partway in Jiang Shang's place, as thanks for saving me.
Thanks a lot, old-timer...
The battle's going badly. Better hurry to the Xiqi battlefield!
N-No way! A huge boulder's blocking the entrance...
Sigh~ What are we going to do...???
Sighing won't make the rock move itself! Get over here and help push!
You dare boss ME around?! You got a death wish?
I-I mean... didn't a villager say there's a super-strong Yellow Turban warrior in Yellow Turban Cave? Maybe he could move the boulder.
Oh yeah! Why didn't I think of that? Miss Yang Jian, you're so smart...
Oh, stop it~ You'll make this maiden blush...
Quit acting cute, hag!
Oh! Look! A bear flying in the sky!
Yeowch~ That hurts~ D-Damn it! That sneaky witch...
Brother Ji Fa~ Look, Brother Pingyan is picking on me again...
Scrawny monkey, how could you pick on a girl!
Pingyan~
Fine, I get it~ You win this round...
Tee hee hee~
No use, can't get in... We need the Yellow Turban warrior's help first!
The entrance is blocked by a boulder!
Your turn to shine, Yellow Turban!
Hmph! Child's play! Watch this! Hyah!
Great job!
Let's go! Next stop: Feilong Cave~
I'm gonna skin that Tu Xingsun alive...
N-Nothing! This maiden meant Tu Xingsun must return the Phoenix Bone intact. We need it to heal Ancient South~
Miss Yang Jian, you're so kind!
Oh, don't say that~ Brother Leizhenzi~
There's no justice... no justice in this world...
What did you say?
I said it's getting late, O kind, lovely, gentle young lady! Let's get moving!
Right! Let's go!
Looks like there's a strange seal here,
This must be the seal holding Shaobai! Let's free him fast, so Xiaoyu can rest in peace!
I am the Fulong Sage, warden of this sealed beast. Who broke this seal? Name yourself!
I'm Ji Pingyan! To save Xiaoyu's soul in Qingfeng Village, I'm taking Shaobai... even if I must fight you!
You truly think this beast is so loyal?
I do! All living things have hearts. Even a fox spirit has feelings...
...Who's there? Did you say Xiaoyu? Where is she? Take me to her! I beg you, Fulong Sage... Let me see her once, and I'll give up 3000 years of cultivation...
......Ji Pingyan, was it? Defeat me, and you may take Shaobai...
Forgive me, Fulong Sage...
Take Shaobai...
Thank you, Fulong Sage... You went easy on me...
Say no more, or I may change my mind.
Fulong Sage... I'll keep my promise... Thank you...
Shaobai! Hurry, come back to Qingfeng Village with me!
If Heaven had feelings, even Heaven would grow old... Sigh...
Why have you barged into my cave?
Hey! Look who's asking questions... Where's the Phoenix Bone? Hand it over!
No! Chanyu promised she'd marry me if I got the Phoenix Bone, so I can't give it to you...
So you want to do this the hard way!
Beakface! Let me handle this... Tu Xingsun, we need the Phoenix Bone for an elixir to save Ancient South. Please give it back.
No! No way, no how! It's the love token for my marriage to Chanyu. I can't just hand it over to you...
What are you talking about?! Hand it over? It was OURS before you swiped it! Don't play the victim, you thief!
Why waste breath on him? Just knock him out and take it! Pea brain!
Hand over the Phoenix Bone, NOW!
Waaah~ No! No! Even if you beat me to death! No Phoenix Bone, no wife! For Chanyu, I'd die first...
Fine! I'll grant your wish right now!
Stop it, hag! Beating an honest guy to death isn't worth it.
H-Hag?
Tu Xingsun, how about this? Take us to meet this Deng Chanyu. I'll explain how important the Phoenix Bone is to us. Once she understands, I'm sure she'll agree to marry you.
Sniff~ Okay! I'll take you by Earth Travel! She went looking for some immortal. She should be on Mount Zhongnan!
M-Mount Zhongnan!? Ha ha! What luck... That's where my master's cave is...
Talk about dumb luck!
Great, let's go, Tu Xingsun!
Leave it to me!
This is as far as I go. Past Jialong Mountain lies Zhaoge's land. Until we meet again...
Thank you, old-timer!
A night's stay is 20 silver.
A night's stay is 20 silver.
A night's stay is 20 silver.
What can I get you?
How will we ever explain this to Nezha's parents?
Nezha... It's all my fault... If not for me... you wouldn't have...
......Scrawny monkey...
What's done is done. Brooding won't help. Nezha said his father Li Jing is very learned. Let's go to Chentang Pass, tell Li Jing what happened, and ask about the Phoenix Bone.
Scrawny monkey! Move it or we're leaving you behind!
It's my fault... all of this is my fault...
Scrawny monkey! Is moping fair to Nezha? I couldn't stand the brat... but he...
You birdbrain! That hurt!!
......Let's go already! Chentang Pass, right? Hurry or I'll leave you!
I'm an idiot for worrying about you!!
Well, no need to worry anymore...
Thanks... Lei... zhen... I mean! Beakface!
What did you say?
Nothing! I said let's get going!
No way! What did you just say? I didn't catch it!
You're so annoying! Let's go!
What did you say? What did you say? Say it again! Hey...
Welcome to Chentang Pass.
There are two divine artifacts in Chentang Pass!
So scary!
What's so scary?
That weird bird next to you, mister! Waaah~ Help~
......Why, you little brat!
Waaah~ Help~ Please don't eat me~
Lord Li Jing lives right inside!
Nezha's always made his parents mad. What a bad kid...
What do I do? I lost the ring Xiaodong gave me... Could you help me find it?
That's my lost ring! Thank you... Here, take this!
Thank you!
Got Vase Nectar!
Why are there so many demons lately?
We meet again. I see a dark miasma about you... I have an ominous feeling! Did someone important pass away recently...? But...
How did you know? But what? Go on...
Heaven's secrets must not be told...
Heaven's secrets must not be told...
Curious! Curious!
What does that mean? Why do you two always talk so weird?
Heaven's secrets must not be told...
Heaven's secrets must not be told...
So hot!
Lord Li Jing's son Nezha spent three and a half years in the womb. A freak!
My wife's expecting. Hope she doesn't give birth to a ball of flesh...
Oh, don't worry!
There are hidden summon beasts in this world. You must meet certain conditions to get them!
Nezha's a little rascal, but I know deep down he's a good kid!
